req_desc: The product serves visitors browsing a studio's client work plus the studio publishing that work, as one application.
French is served without a prefix as the default locale, English under a prefix.
A qualified enquiry ends the visitor's journey, becoming a record the studio answers on a clock.
The application contacts no outside origin at run time other than the named mail server.
An anonymous visitor reads every published project, expertise record, person, award in the requested locale ...
Authorization is decided in one place taking the principal, the action, the subject, never once per handler ...
Signup is open, a new account being an `editor` holding no records.
Four accounts are seeded: `editor@example.com`, `editor2@example.com`, `commercial@example.com`, `commercial2@example.com` ...
`POST /api/auth/signup` creates an account, returning a bearer token ...
`POST /api/auth/login` returns a bearer token for a seeded address with the corpus password ...
Every route under `/api/console/` refuses a request carrying no bearer token.
An anonymous visitor requesting a console address is sent to `/atelier/connexion/`, returning afterwards to the requested address.
Signing out returns the visitor to `/`, invalidating the token so a later request carrying the token is denied.
Nine public route shapes exist in French without a prefix, nine in English under `/en/`.
Every public address ends in a trailing slash, being lowercase throughout ...
The site never redirects on the browser's language header.
The language switch resolves through the record's translation group, leading to the paired record.
A record holding no published translation renders the switch disabled, carrying an explanation ...
The chosen language is remembered on the visitor's own device, being offered later as a suggestion rather than a redirect.
Every route declares a language matching what the route renders.
`GET /api/catalogue` takes a `locale` of `fr` or `en`, answering only with records published in that locale.
The catalogue renders published projects as a three-tier mosaic of feature cards, secondary cards, list rows ...
A total sits above the mosaic, counting the published projects in the requested locale.
Four discipline facets sit above the mosaic, each carrying a live count ...
A project carries one discipline or several, so the four counts sum above the total.
The four counts plus the cards beneath come from one read, describing the same instant.
The filter bar offers an any-filter mode plus an all-filter mode, the count reflecting the chosen mode.
The clear control reads `Tout effacer` in French, `Clear all` in English.
The whole filter state lives in the address, so a copied address reproduces the view in a fresh session ...
Applying a filter changes the address, reloading that address rendering the same set from the server.
A filter combination matching nothing renders the empty panel carrying a zero total plus the clear control ...
A locale holding no published project renders `Bientot` over `Les projets arrivent. En attendant, parlons du votre.`.
A card's hover content lives in the card's accessible name, being visible without hover on a touch device.
`GET /api/catalogue` returns an object carrying `total`, `facets`, `results`.
A case study renders a hero, a block sequence, a return control.
Eleven block kinds are built, a block being an ordered row rather than a field.
The gap before a block is decided by the pair of kinds, two full-bleed blocks meeting with no gap.
A full-bleed image block carries two crops, reaching no published state with one.
An autoplaying video block carries a description, reaching no published state without one.
Every content image carries alternative text or a decorative declaration, the preflight naming any block missing both.
An inline video holding no source renders a poster under the controls, carrying a line saying no source is attached.
The return control restores the catalogue's filters plus the scroll position the visitor left.
`quai-douze` is published in French alone, so the switch on that record explains itself.
A carousel is operable from the keyboard, the position being announced.
A statistics row renders stored figures rather than text typed into a paragraph.
The call-to-action block leads to the contact route in the same locale.
The home route renders five bands in order: hero, pinned sequence, feature rail, catalogue column, award panel.
The home route carries one first-level heading, a visually hidden heading standing behind the drawn wordmark.
Adding a fourth featured project lengthens the pinned sequence rather than compressing the contents.
The pinned sequence unpins in a short landscape window, rendering as stacked sections.
The pinned sequence unpins on a struggling machine, becoming stacked sections rather than stuttering.
The feature rail is keyboard reachable in a linear reading order, stacking vertically at the narrow arrangement.
The award panel names `Webframe`, `DDA`, each carrying a count ...
The expertise route renders five services, each carrying a skill list, beside drawn letter tiles ...
The agency route renders the studio's story, a three-word marquee, the team, the awards, the clients.
The contact route renders three entry cards, each leading to a branch of the funnel ...
The footer carries `contact@example.com`, `jobs@example.com`, the phone number rendered once ...
A record is a translation group holding one row per locale.
A record moves through `draft`, `in_review`, `scheduled`, `published`, `withdrawn`, any other transition being refused.
The preflight returns every unmet obligation rather than the first.
A publish attempt on `lune-basse` names two unmet obligations.
A publish is one transaction across the state, the slug history, the redirect, the revision, the invalidation.
Publishing one project rebuilds that route, the catalogue, the counts, the sitemap, never the whole site.
A publish writes a revision naming the actor plus the instant, restorable into draft.
A failed scheduled publish stays scheduled, raising an alert before a retry.
Creating a project runs through three addressed steps, each reachable by a link of its own.
A reordered block moves before the server answers, a refused reorder returning the row to the prior position.
Rank is rebalanced across the list, so inserting a block rewrites no whole project.
A second write against a record already changed is refused, naming the editor responsible.
Changing a published slug writes a permanent redirect from the old path automatically.
Slug history is per locale, a French rename touching no English address.
A redirect chain is served in one hop, never through an intermediate address ...
Withdrawing a record requires a choice between gone status plus a redirect target ...
A redirect target is a path beginning with one slash or an allow-listed address, rejected at write, rejected again at serve.
`GET /api/console/redirects` lists every redirect with source, target, status, origin.
A sitemap lists every published address in the locale, every internal link on every public route resolving.
The project branch runs over three addressed steps, the application branch over two, the question branch over one.
The funnel controls read `Retour`, `Continuer`, `Envoyer`, `Envoi en cours`.
The draft is held on the visitor's own device, surviving a reload, a closed tab, a refused submit.
Validation names the field inline, a summary counting what is left to fix ...
A rejected step writes nothing, leaving no partial lead, no orphan answer.
The budget question offers `Je ne sais pas encore` as a real answer.
The consent statement is never pre-selected, the submission being refused without agreement.
Submitting twice under one `Idempotency-Key` produces exactly one lead, the store arbitrating ...
The acknowledgement is committed in the transaction writing the lead.
The acknowledgement is addressed to the one typed address, carrying no carbon copy, no blind carbon copy.
A project acknowledgement subject begins `Nous avons bien recu votre demande`, the reference following a colon ...
The acknowledgement body names the studio, never quoting the submitted payload back.
Only a submission plus an application outcome send mail, a state change sending nothing.
The confirmation route renders `C'est envoye` over a line naming the reference.
A refused submit keeps every answer, a retry reusing the same idempotency key.
A submission judged automated receives the status, the body, the confirmation any other submission receives.
The funnel records the question wording used at submission, the detail view rendering the stored wording.
The lead inbox renders reference, branch, name, subject, state, owner, time left.
A lead moves through `new`, `routed`, `acknowledged`, `in_progress`, `answered`, `closed`, `withdrawn` ...
Every lead is routed to an owner or appears in an unrouted queue, no third place existing.
Closing a lead requires a reason, being refused without one.
Lead text is never rendered as markup anywhere, mail included.
The response-time clock respects the studio's working hours.
`GET /api/console/leads` is readable by `commercial`, refused to `editor` with an absent-record status.
The lead list, the media list, the record list each answer in one query whose count never grows with the rows.
Console list filters live in the address exactly as the public catalogue's do.
A delimited export neutralises a leading character a spreadsheet would read as a formula.
A document is stored under a server-generated identifier, the arriving name being metadata alone.
An upload whose declared type disagrees with the first bytes is rejected.
A document is unreachable until the scan state is `clean`, decided where the bytes are read.
A rejected document is retained carrying the reason, the application staying readable.
The activity entry for a download is written before the download target is issued.
The download endpoint refuses an `editor`, refuses an unauthenticated caller, refuses a document not yet clean ...
Nothing non-essential is written to a visitor's device before a consent decision ...
The consent decision survives a reload, being recorded on the server beside the lead.
A withdrawal completes in one action from the acknowledgement link, asking for confirmation alone.
A withdrawal deletes the derived copies before the primary record, verifying each absence.
A completed withdrawal issues a certificate naming every store the record left.
A withdrawn lead is absent from the inbox, absent from every export, the reference resolving no longer.
A restored backup runs retention before the environment becomes reachable.
Activity entries are append-only at the database grant, no update reaching them, no delete reaching them.
The activity log is rendered to `commercial`, refused to `editor`.
A command palette holds its own address, opening over any console route.
Every console destination is reachable from the palette by typing.
An unavailable search component leaves the console falling back to a plain listing carrying a notice.
The console's record lists render as tables whose deciding column sorts by default.
The console home renders records awaiting review, scheduled publishes due, leads past commitment, documents awaiting a scan.
The console is one locale, never translated.
An unknown address renders the studio's own not-found page, answering with the not-found status ...
A not-found on an English path answers in English, a not-found on a French path answering in French.
The server-failure body reads `Quelque chose a casse de notre cote. Nous sommes prevenus.`.
Every public route carries a title plus a description no other route shares ...
Every public route declares one canonical address, the other locale being declared as the alternate.
The personal-data page states what the studio records, how long the studio keeps each record, how removal happens ...
Every route in the flow table is reachable at the auth level the table names.
An expired token mid-action leaves the action unperformed, asking for sign-in again.
Narrowing the catalogue to one discipline moves the total beside the four counts in one repaint.
A publish moves the public total by one, each carried discipline rising by one.
A renamed French slug leaves `/en/projects/new-harbour/` untouched.
A candidate document is refused until the scan returns clean, the release writing an entry first.
A withdrawal leaves an activity entry no later request updates, no later request deletes.
Every list renders an empty state, no list rendering a blank region ...
The mood is editorial, confident, quiet, the work carrying the argument ...
The root size is a fraction of the window's width, the fraction chosen on orientation ...
Two type families ship, the interface face carrying a regular cut beside a medium cut ...
Fourteen palette roles exist, four card grounds belonging to the record rather than the position ...
Seven easing shapes exist, one house curve carrying the majority, nothing springing ...
The navigation is a full-window overlay holding modal semantics, a focus trap, an escape key, focus returned to the burger ...
Eight structural risks each carry a named repair.
Body text meets the contrast bar, focus rings staying visible against the light ground beside the dark one.
Every surface leads with exactly one primary action, visually distinct from every secondary one.
The application is server-rendered with progressive enhancement, no client framework shipping ...
The catalogue filters, the funnel completes, the navigation opens with scripting unavailable.
Every host, port, credential is read from the environment, never hardcoded, never defaulted silently.
An unavailable mail server leaves the lead written, the confirmation saying an acknowledgement is on the way.
The public site requests no origin the visitor did not choose.
Every response carries a strict transport policy, a nosniff policy, a referrer policy, a frame-ancestors restriction, a permissions policy ...
No credential, token, database address, mail password appears in anything the browser downloads.
Object keys derive from a server-generated identifier, never from a supplied filename.
Cache invalidation bumps a version suffix rather than deleting the key.
Every maintenance operation runs twice with no observable difference.
No personal data reaches a log, enforced by a redaction step at the logging boundary.
Seeding is idempotent, a second start producing the same rows rather than a copy.
A translation group is the identity a record holds across locales.
A project translation carries a locale, a title, a slug, a state, a version.
`project_discipline` is a many-to-many, so a project carries several disciplines.
A block carries a kind, a position within the translation, the referenced media.
`slug_history` records every slug a translation ever carried with the locale.
A redirect stores a source, a target, a status, an origin of automatic or manual.
A lead carries a reference, a branch, an idempotency key unique at the store.
`lead_answer` carries the question text as worded at submission beside the answer.
A document carries a scan state of `pending_scan`, `clean`, `rejected`.
The facet counts, the catalogue total, the block gap, the lead deadline, the card ground are derived rather than stored.
Six French project slugs are seeded: `maison-carre`, `atelier-brune`, `port-neuf`, `serre-verte`, `lune-basse`, `quai-douze` ...
Every length in the system is a multiple of the root, no component introducing another unit ...
Five width tiers exist, no component receiving a sixth breakpoint of its own.
The responsive matrix names a narrow, intermediate, wide behaviour for every surface.
Ink on the page ground clears the strictest contrast level, the accent ground carrying display type alone ...
Exactly two typeface requests occur on a cold route load, none on a warm one.
The year badge holds no fixed width, fitting a five-character value ...
The language switch marks the current locale as current rather than colouring alone.
Three catalogue card shapes share one base carrying the ground, the overlay, the container.
One scroll engine plus one lock stack exist for the life of the document.
Generated imagery is deterministic on the record identifier, a rebuild changing nothing ...
The delivery tree carries no image file, no video file, no typeface file, no model, no vector file ...
The application is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL`, the mapping being `${APP_PUBLIC_PORT}:4173` ...
A plain list endpoint returns a top-level JSON array, the catalogue endpoint returning an object ...
The lead, the answers, the consent record, the redirect, the revision, the activity entry are real rows in `postgres` ...
